On Steam Workshop

Description:
Quick Draw

Equip weapons, fight, walk, throw objects and customize weapon grips with a small set of context-sensitive controls.

Quick Draw adds fast weapon handling, combat automation, custom walking and a full per-weapon Main Hand / Grip Editor for humans and androids. It is designed to work with both vanilla and modded weapons.

Controls

F on a humanoid — draw the nearest suitable item into a free hand. If it is out of reach, the humanoid can walk to it first.
F on a hand — drop the held item.
F on the head — attack/use the held item. If unarmed, fetch a suitable weapon first.
F on an upper leg, lower leg or foot — toggle automatic walking.
R on a humanoid — turn around.
G on a held weapon — open the Grip / Main Hand Editor.

Select multiple humanoids or multiple legs/feet first and the same action can be applied to the whole group.

F and R follow the game’s own bindings. The editor key can be changed in Quick Draw settings.

Walking

Quick Draw includes an optional Modded Walking style. It is deliberately looser and less aggressive than the normal walk and can be switched back to Vanilla at any time.

  • Press F on either leg or foot to start/stop auto-walking.
  • Select legs or feet from several humanoids to make all of them start or stop together.
  • Auto-walking follows the humanoid’s current facing direction.
  • Attack Movement: Keep walking lets characters fire, stab, wield and throw while still moving.
  • Attack Movement: Stop to attack pauses walking for the attack and resumes afterwards.
  • The same movement behavior can be used during Purge.

Quick Equip

Weapons are mirrored, rotated and gripped automatically, including main hand, support hand, one- or two-handed carry and carry pose.

  • Built-in grip profiles cover vanilla and many modded weapon shapes.
  • Unknown items are handled from their own shape, holding points and components instead of requiring hard-coded support.
  • Humanoids can walk to out-of-reach weapons, turn around, stop at the item and pick it up.
  • Held poses use the body’s own muscles instead of hard-locking the limbs.
  • Drawing a second item can free the support hand from a two-handed weapon.
  • Living characters, corpses, arrows, bolts and other compatible items are supported.

Combat

Point at a humanoid’s head and press F. Select several humanoids first to send all of them into action together.

Guns

  • Aim and fire at the nearest valid target in front.
  • Burst, keep-firing and multi-target behavior are configurable.
  • Dual-wielded guns can fire together or alternate.
  • Recoil is reflected through the arm instead of being visually ignored.

Throwing & Stabbing

  • Grenades, objects and throwable weapons are aimed and thrown automatically.
  • Grenades can arm automatically and nearby characters can flee the blast.
  • Fast throws use continuous collision handling.
  • Two held throwables can be used together or alternated.
  • Pointed melee weapons can stab at close range instead of being thrown.

Tools & Powered Weapons

  • Saws, powered blades, stunners and compatible modded tools can be carried into the target and activated.
  • Safety checks prevent the working end from being activated directly through the holder’s own body.

Teams & Targeting

Select multiple humanoids, right-click one and choose Create Team. Team members are treated as allies and are avoided by Quick Draw targeting.

Spare is a separate per-humanoid protection toggle that prevents Quick Draw attackers from targeting that character.

Targets are tracked as people rather than as one fixed limb. If the aimed limb is lost or blocked, Quick Draw can switch to another valid body part.

Purge

Enable Purge and living humanoids arm themselves, seek valid enemies and keep fighting until Purge is disabled.

They can walk to weapons, turn when necessary, pick them up and continue combat. With Keep walking enabled, they can attack while moving; with Stop to attack, they stop for the attack and then continue walking.

Grip Editor / Main Hand Editor

Press G on a held weapon during normal play.

  • Move and rotate the weapon.
  • Reposition main and support grips.
  • Edit one- and two-handed poses.
  • Choose whether the weapon shoots, stabs, wields, throws or does nothing.
  • Set custom tip and front points anywhere on the object, including attached parts.
  • Configure throw behavior and per-weapon throw power.
  • Copy poses between weapons or apply settings to multiple weapon types.
  • Save profiles per weapon type, including modded weapons.

Settings

Quick Draw has its own settings tab for pickup behavior, walking style, attack movement, shooting, gunfights, throwing, stabbing, targeting, turning, Purge, the grip editor and developer options.

Designed for vanilla and modded content.
Tune the combat behavior, customize weapon grips and decide whether your characters stop to fight or attack on the move.
